Built financial models to forecast monthly cash outflows and working capital requirements; used Excel to create dashboards for stakeholder review. Ensured compliance with GST and TDS regulations, coordinated statutory filings and improved invoice-to-pay cycle efficiency by streamlining AP workflows.

Skills: Tally, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable, Microsoft Excel, Financial Modeling, Linux

Education: B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
